g.text: Checkout and payment · Customer, frontend, backend and Stripe
[A pending order of their own is holding the stock]
It's not an out-of-stock: the remedy is to pay
the pending order or wait for it to expire
A different coupon, more cart, or the discounted
Reserves stock, holds one coupon use
and creates the PENDING order with expiresAt
The front clears the cart badge on the 201,
The periodic sweep picks it up
Mounts the Payment Element with the clientSecret
Confirms the card or the second method
Card data never passes through the API.
That's what keeps the PCI scope where it is
Stripe retries for up to three days. A legitimate
event rejected by a misconfigured secret
lands as soon as it's fixed
Idempotency lives in the database constraint,
The order may still read PENDING
Records the refund; the order ends up CANCELLED
The payment stays recorded as succeeded.
The sweep, which also has an origin
[Repeatable job the worker registers in BullMQ on startup]
Releases the stock and returns the coupon use
releasing the stock. The other way
around, a payment landing in that window leaves a paid order
whose units have already been sold to someone else.
